_description: PR 7 seed. Bay Area punk/ska + 90s alt-rock beyond grunge + Faith No More. Direct-ingest bands: 8 Bay Area punk/ska/alt (Green Day, Rancid, Operation Ivy, NOFX, The Offspring, Faith No More, Mr. Bungle, Fantomas already in graph so skipped) + 11 alt-rock (Breeders, Belly, Throwing Muses, Guided by Voices, Pavement, Yo La Tengo, Sleater-Kinney, Built to Spill, Dinosaur Jr., The Lemonheads, Cake, They Might Be Giants). Bridge-persons for gap-fill (Billie Joe, Fat Mike, Jesse Michaels for Op Ivy split, Mike Patton to bridge Mr. Bungle/Fantomas/Faith No More clusters). 8 new common-name pins added (Rancid, Belly, Cake, Pavement, Lemonheads, NOFX, Faith No More, plus pre-existing).
